definitions.gloss: lay judge (citizen judge in Japanese criminal trials)
definitions.explanation: A citizen chosen at random from the electoral roll to sit with professional judges in serious criminal trials under the {裁判員制度|さいばんいんせいど}, introduced in 2009. Six lay judges and three professional judges decide together on guilt and on the sentence.

examples.japanese: {裁判員|さいばんいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I was chosen as a lay judge.

examples.japanese: {裁判員|さいばんいん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: Lay judges are chosen from among ordinary citizens.

examples.japanese: {裁判員|さいばんいん}⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{裁判官|さいばんかん}→裁判官：09562_saibankan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{有罪|ゆうざい}→有罪：13003_yuuzai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{無罪|むざい}→無罪：13383_muzai⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{刑|けい}→刑：02786_kei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重|おも}さ→重さ：14444_omosa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: In lay-judge trials, citizens and judges together decide guilt or innocence and the sentence.

notes:
Unlike an American jury, lay judges deliberate together with the professional judges and also decide the sentence. They are bound by confidentiality about the deliberations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裁判員|さいばんいん}{制度|せいど}: the lay-judge system
- {裁判員|さいばんいん}⟦{裁判|さいばん}→裁判：02773_saiban⟧: a lay-judge trial
- {裁判員|さいばんいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to be selected as a lay judge
- {裁判員|さいばんいん}⟦{候補者|こうほしゃ}→候補者：20439_kouhosha⟧: a prospective lay judge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{裁判官|さいばんかん}→裁判官：09562_saibankan⟧: professional judge
- {陪審員|ばいしんいん}: juror (in a jury system such as the American one)
